# Standard Operating Procedure: Laboratory Inventory

## 1. Purpose and Scope
This document describes the mandatory verification protocol for hazardous chemical inventories across analytical research facilities.

## 2. Safety Guidelines
- All personnel must wear certified protective eyewear and nitrile gloves.
- Spill containment kits must be inspected every thirty days.
- Ensure proper ventilation prior to opening solvent containers.

## 3. Incident Notification
In the event of an accidental discharge or contact with skin, immediately flush the area with copious amounts of water for at least fifteen minutes and notify the environmental safety supervisor.
